gaps.explanation: The budget schedules count sale of assets in 'Local' receipts, the governmental funds statement prints it under Other Financing Sources. p8 General Fund budget schedule Local 999,197 = p5 General Fund column Local 998,897 + Sale of assets 300; p9 Road Fund budget schedule Local 56,455 = p4 Road Fund Local 52,750 + Sale of assets 3,705. p4 Total column: Sale of assets 4,005 (other financing), receipts 7,215,928. Schedule 7,219,933 - 7,215,928 = 4,005 = 300 + 3,705. Nothing missing or duplicated.

p4 statement Transfers - in 1,353,608 (General 82,598, Road 1,263,056, ARPA 7,286, Non-Major 668). Detail records the General Fund sub-funds gross from the p5 combining page/p8 schedule: General 882,416 + Inheritance Tax 82,598 + Emergency Management 30,000 = 995,014 (p5 Total General Fund), while the p4 General Fund column nets the 912,416 transferred among the General Fund sub-funds (995,014 - 82,598). The p9 Road Fund budget schedule prints one net 'Transfers - in' 1,180,458 (= 1,263,056 in - 82,598 out). Detail 2,183,426 - statement 1,353,608 = 829,818 = 912,416 (intra-General Fund, gross in detail) - 82,598 (netted on the Road Fund schedule). Both are how the printed schedules present transfers; no line missing or duplicated.

p4 statement Transfers - out (1,353,608) = General (1,271,010) + Road (82,598). Detail: General Fund -1,408,426 (p8) + Inheritance Tax Fund -775,000 (p5) = 2,183,426 = p5 Total General Fund transfers out, i.e. gross including 912,416 transferred among the General Fund sub-funds (2,183,426 - 1,271,010); the Road Fund's 82,598 out is netted into its p9 budget schedule's single 'Transfers - in' 1,180,458. Detail 2,183,426 - 1,353,608 = 829,818 = 912,416 - 82,598. Presentation difference only.
